question: Which brand manufactures the product 'Michael Jackson Ladies Perfume With Hologram. Ladies Eau De Toilette - Natural Spray. 60 ML 2.0 US FL. OZ'?
model_answer:
The brand that manufactures the 'Michael Jackson Ladies Perfume With Hologram. Ladies Eau De Toilette - Natural Spray. 60 ML 2.0 US FL. OZ' is G.P.S. Gem Perfumes S.A. This unique perfume is part of a range that was originally intended for release in the early 1990s but faced significant delays and was never officially released commercially.

The perfume is a fascinating collector's item with an interesting history. It was created in Paris through a collaboration between Michael Jackson himself and the renowned perfumer Jon Pierre Sand. The product features a high-quality hologram of Michael Jackson on the bottle, which shows the singer smiling when the bottle is turned. This hologram version is considered the rarest and most sought-after of the bottle types.

The perfume comes in a 60 ML (2.0 US FL. OZ) bottle and was part of a planned line that included both a women's perfume (Mystique de Michael Jackson) and a men's cologne (Legende de Michael Jackson). The project was licensed by Victor Chiam, but unfortunately, his death and subsequent legal issues with his estate led to the delayed and ultimately cancelled release of the perfumes.

Interestingly, a full media launch, including TV advertising and promotional store posters, was prepared and ready to go just days before Michael Jackson faced false accusations from the Chandler family, which further contributed to the perfume line never being commercially released. As a result, these perfumes have become highly coveted collectors' items.
